title: Google Expands Search AI Mode Advertising to International Markets

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google is adding sponsored listings to the AI-powered interface of its search engine for users in global markets to monetize conversational queries on a larger scale. This rollout marks the first time the company has expanded its AI Mode advertising beyond the U.S., where it is also introducing multi-turn ads that appear during an ongoing dialogue between the user and the AI.

The company stated that the move targets a segment of users whose AI queries are incremental rather than replacements for traditional search behavior. According to internal data, the click-through rates for sponsored product listings in AI Mode are currently comparable to those of organic listings.
